The current Bahawalpur polygon layer was inspected through its public viewer token route; exact WUP point returned no feature, while a bounded query returned three safe-ID parcel polygons. The packet is complete but runtime remains held for serial review.

They identified official Punjab land-record, PULSE cadastral-map, ArcGIS service-directory, Board of Revenue, and Bahawalpur/Ahmedpur East planning sources. No separate local Ahmedpur East public parcel API was identified.

ArcGIS metadata confirmed Bahawalpur layer 2, Polygon geometry, native OBJECTID, and EPSG:3857. Untokenized metadata returned HTTP 499. Exact-point query returned zero features; bounded query returned three polygons with exceededTransferLimit=true. No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, TLS disablement, formal submission, or contact was used.
